evals.name: visible-row
evals.prompt: An old recording shows Aster after registration. Recover the supported claims.
evals.expected_output: A bounded observation with an explicit inference boundary.
assertions: Records the observed row and evidence source.
Does not infer a stream ID or event count.
Names evidence needed to check those claims.

evals.name: missing-refusal
evals.prompt: No trace shows a blank submission. Should the new model assume the old service rejected it?
assertions: Separates proposed policy from recovered behavior.
Requests a decision or bounded evidence rather than launching extraction.

evals.name: inconsistent
evals.prompt: A screenshot and a service trace disagree about when the row appeared. Write the comparison.
evals.expected_output: A scoped discrepancy rather than a guessed implementation.
assertions: Records the caller and sampling window of each source.
Lists plausible alternatives without declaring one fact.
Names a discriminating observation and owner.
